newsitem.title: USA: Fresh Choice sees loss in current quarter.
newsitem.headline: Fresh Choice sees loss in current quarter.

text.p: Fresh Choice Inc said Wednesday it expects to post a loss in the first quarter due to heavy spending on advertising.

The company today reported a 1996 fourth quarter loss of $0.28 a share and said it had launched an aggressive marketing campaign to help boost sales. Fresh Choice is promoting itself on television for the first time, on radio and in print.
"Early returns on this effort are encouraging," Jeff Jefferson, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "With the large advertising investment, however, we expect a loss in this quarter."
